# BundleReport

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class BundleReport
```

The text report for an upload bundle, rendered in Core so `inspect` and any other surface say the identical thing. Invariant, like every other figure this product prints.

## Methods

### Render(LoadedBundle) { #m-render-nfty-core-publish-loadedbundle }

```csharp
public static string Render(LoadedBundle bundle);
```

Renders what a bundle holds: how many items, how many pictures resolve, the collection file, every trait with its values, and anything that could not be read.

**Parameters**

- `bundle` (`LoadedBundle`) - The bundle.

**Returns.** The report, ending in a newline.
